name: $\vec{F}_{net} = 0$
content: Newton's first law condition for a particle at rest or in motion at constant velocity[cite: 1]

name: $\frac{\vec{F}_{1}}{\vec{a}_{1}} = \frac{\vec{F}_{2}}{\vec{a}_{2}} = m = \text{constant}$
content: Ratio of force to acceleration defining the mass of a particle[cite: 1]

name: $\vec{F}_{\text{second on first}} = -\vec{F}_{\text{first on second}}$
content: Newton's third law of motion (action and reaction)[cite: 1]

name: $\vec{F}_{21} = -\frac{Gm_{1}m_{2}}{r_{21}^{2}}\hat{r}_{21}$
content: Newton's law of gravitation in vector form[cite: 1]

name: $w = mg$
content: Weight of a body as gravitational force[cite: 1]

name: $g = G\frac{M}{R^{2}}$
content: Acceleration due to gravity near the earth's surface[cite: 1]

name: $v = v_{0} + gt$
content: First equation of motion for free fall[cite: 1]

name: $v^{2} = v_{0}^{2} + 2gh$
content: Second equation of motion for free fall[cite: 1]

name: $h = v_{0}t + \frac{1}{2}gt^{2}$
content: Third equation of motion for free fall[cite: 1]

name: $\vec{p}_{A} + \vec{p}_{B} = \vec{p}_{A}^{\prime} + \vec{p}_{B}^{\prime}$
content: Law of conservation of momentum in vector form[cite: 1]

name: $m_{A}\vec{v}_{A} + m_{B}\vec{v}_{B} = m_{A}\vec{v}_{A}^{\prime} + m_{B}\vec{v}_{B}^{\prime}$
content: Conservation of momentum for a two-body collision[cite: 1]

name: $m_{B} = m_{A}\frac{v_{A}^{\prime}}{v_{B}^{\prime}}$
content: Measurement of inertial mass using a compressed spring[cite: 1]
